title: Bucket o' Blobbo
description: Replaces textures of bucket of cod and bucket of salmon to a bucket of blobfish.
body:
## Ever Wanted a cute **blobfish** in a bucket?
Well Now you can!
This replaces bucket of cod and bucket of salmon to be buckets of blobfish.
Also renames them accordingly: 
Bucket of Salmon -> Bucket of Blobmon
Bucket of Cod -> Bucket of Codfish
